name: search
description: Full-text site search powered by FlexSearch. UI skeleton in search.html partial. Search data injected by Foundry build pipeline as window.__FOUNDRY_PAGES__. Supports Chinese/English, fuzzy search, real-time results.

params.description: Enable the search capability. Base injects window.__MDF_SEARCH__.pages data via scripts-body-end/search-data.html.
params.effect: Renders search trigger and loads FlexSearch modal

params.description: Where to place the search trigger: 'header' (default, auto-placed in header/extra.html) | 'sidebar' (sub-theme calls partial 'search-trigger.html' or inline shell in sidebar) | 'none' (sub-theme places trigger manually)
params.effect: Controls trigger placement only. UI mode is controlled by search.variant.

params.description: Search UI mode: 'modal' (default, unified FlexSearch overlay) | 'inline' (Quartz-style sidebar expand with results + HTML preview). Inline requires search.content=true and sub-theme .search markup shell.
params.effect: modal → caps/search/search.js + search.html; inline → caps/search/search-inline.js (no modal HTML)

params.description: Enable CJK (Chinese/Japanese/Korean) tokenizer for better search accuracy with CJK scripts.
params.effect: Adds character-level tokenization — required for meaningful Chinese/Japanese/Korean search results

params.description: Include full content index in window.__MDF_SEARCH__.content for excerpt previews and Graph visualization.
params.effect: Enables search result excerpts and match highlighting; required when params.graph = true

params.description: Keyboard shortcut key to open the search modal. Set to empty string to disable.
params.effect: Registers a keydown listener for the specified key. Default: '/'

css.note: No standalone CSS. Sub-theme styles .mdf-search, .mdf-search__input, .mdf-search__results in main.css

js.note: Load via scripts-body-end/extra.html override in sub-theme when search is enabled

locked.reason: Search JS reads #mdf-search-input and writes to #mdf-search-results

css_in_main.note: Style search UI via these classes in main.css

partials.note: Override to customize the search UI HTML. Keep #mdf-search-input and #mdf-search-results ids.
Call partial 'search.html' here when search is enabled
Inject FlexSearch CDN + initialization JS here
